title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Partial replacement of Ni by Cd from a CdS support converts Ln52Ni56 into a cocatalyst that separates charge and supplies HER sites, with the Eu analogue giving very high visible-light hydrogen evolution.
explanation: Ln52Ni56-xCdx/CdS is formed by supporting the cluster on two-dimensional CdS so that Cd substitutes some Ni. The Eu52Ni56-xCdx/CdS composite is reported at 25,353 μmol h−1 g−1, attributed to in situ Eu(II) centers plus photogenerated electrons in CdS.
scope: IDA Ln52Ni56 clusters on CdS for photocatalytic hydrogen evolution.
conditions: Visible-light irradiation at wavelengths of at least 420 nm; Cd substitution from the CdS support.
caveats: The rate is for the cited Eu composite, not a general activity of all Ln52Ni56 clusters.
